cells.label: Why this verdict
cells.value: Changes manifests, adds a license and private-flag check, adds a Signed-off-by refusal to worktree publish, and writes the contributing and legal documents. No thesis speaks to licensing, and no capability row moves: publication.bootstrap stays latent because the order's own non-goals exclude publishing anything, and the new guard exists to refuse a publish rather than to produce an artifact. Not drift: exclusion 4 keeps local and private distribution complete, and nothing here narrows distribution; the DCO rule binds contributors, not owners. Surfaces: devops gains two checked mechanisms that replace a repeated manual read, the license and hash refusals in check-surfaces and the DCO refusal in publish; the showrunner gains a release control that refuses an accidental package publish. Criterion 6 is the only guard on the clean-room floor for this order because it lands before the local-terms check exists; the reviewer's read of CONTRIBUTING.md against the floor should be recorded as what was read and what was found, not as a checkbox.

cells.label: Why this verdict
cells.value: The one-paragraph story's own sentence made executable: each correction becomes a typed mechanism attached only where relevant, and a session gets a build, not a biography. The target lowers the ten units to rung 2 permissions and hooks, rung 7 role skills, and a rung 8 residue with a byte count. Criterion 3 anchors every hook's allow or refuse decision to feedbackBoundary on the same host facts, so enforcement is a lowering of the kernel's boundary rather than a second rule set, which is the core bet's runtime-lowering posture. Criterion 6 is the strongest sentence in the horizon: it counts every file the floor or the skill directs, rewrites the read order per role, and refuses relocation into a skill as a way to pass. Creates compiler.harness-v1 and harness.self-hosted. Exclusion 1 supports the order rather than refuting it: harnesses are hosted as observed environments, and criterion 1's phase 0 record with cited profile rows is that posture. Exclusion 2 is not triggered because the profile abstraction and the declared Codex limit keep this from being one vendor's harness made nicer, but it stays a watch item until a second profile is fully observed. Surfaces: the engineer defines the Contributor loadout and reads its cost per rung; devops gets harness emit and harness check inside the gate; the tester gets one synthetic-payload fixture per hook proving the decision equals the boundary and that removing the unit makes the hook allow. Weakness: criterion 4 lets the correction unit pass with its token unconfirmed, and that unit is the only live foothold of the correction-to-mechanism loop in this horizon.

cells.label: Why this verdict
cells.value: Horizon 1 is workstreams, disposable workers, and evidence-backed completion, and the thesis names one outcome spanning multiple repositories as the workstream application's route. A control plane that runs from a launchpad outside core, drives bounded orders against registered target repositories, and leaves those trees only conventional branches and pull requests is the precondition for that route. The export that carries the Contributor bundle with the pinned runtime build extends the one-paragraph story to a fork from its first commit, and the overlay that replaces the identity, unequips units, or declares build none keeps the platform from prescribing the loadout, which the story requires. Offline npm ci against the exported lockfile satisfies exclusion 4. Creates launchpad.starter. Surfaces: the showrunner gets target orders, no-release dispositions, and worktree sync with three refusal cases; devops gets the export generator, manifest hashes, the camouflage lint, and harness check inside the export; the engineer gets the overlay as the fork's build-editing surface. Two notes for verification: criterion 5 bundles more than a dozen distinct proofs into one criterion, so a verifier's finding will be coarse and any one failure holds all of them; and criterion 6, the sync helper, has no thesis of its own and is machinery riding a thesis-advancing order.

cells.label: Why this verdict
cells.value: Advisory verdict, because this order builds the instrument type rendering it. The mission thesis says verification should happen automatically when authorized and that investment should favor capabilities that remove recurring supervision; reading a planning horizon against the vision is recurring supervision the operator performs by hand today, and the product lead's standing question, is this still the thing we mean, gets a mechanical answer cell that WO-032 criterion 5 then binds to. The core bet's interchangeable actor slot is exercised in earnest: a compiled read-only loadout dispatched through an existing transport occupies the verifier slot. That also moves runtime.independent-verification off latent in substance, since its row note says review reports are process precedent rather than runtime behavior, and this order makes a review a runtime episode; criterion 6 names only control.plan-refutation and should either date that second row or say why not. Not drift: the non-goals refuse a numeric alignment score, which honors exclusion 6; the override requires a recorded event naming the hold, the actor, and a capture hash, which honors the mission's refusal of silent self-certification; and criterion 4 discloses the self-referential instrument. Surfaces: the product lead gets a verdict per order tied to a thesis or exclusion; the showrunner gets a pass gated by a receipt plus the hold and override path; devops gets the subject builder, the validator, and the evidence-gate check; the tester gets a loadout whose refusals are fixture-pinned. Nothing here is evidence for the order's own criterion 4.

cells.label: Why this verdict
cells.value: The core bet says the smallest loop, declare intent, see what the system understood, observe authorized progress, receive timely feedback, and inspect evidence, must feel legible before features are added. A read-only board whose every claim links to its evidence is that legibility surface, and organizing it around actors, with a person as an actor drawn from the control log, matches exclusion 1's identity: the shared substrate on which people and software actors hold work, authority, and evidence. The Builds panel's hash equality with the compiled-diff receipt applies the differentiated-interface view law to a projection. Creates projection.uifa-board and gives the staged projection.worker-status and projection.control-beacon slices a home. Roles: criterion 5 refuses self-labeling and requires a pinned question-to-cell mapping that the verifier reviews against the roles table. On the subject's text the mapping is product lead to the Blueprint refutation-verdict cell, showrunner to the Work panel's phase, blockers, next legal action, and releases, engineer to the Builds panel's loadout cards, tester to the Mechanisms panel's observed counts with unobserved marked, and devops to the Mechanisms panel's rung, boundary, and enforcement. The engineer's cost question and the devops question are the thinnest answers and the verifier should press them. Dependency note: criterion 1 asserts that refutation receipts dated 2026-09-06 already exist as the fixture source, while WO-041, sequenced before this order, is what defines and validates the receipt shape; if WO-041 changes that shape, this order's pinned JSON and the product lead's cell pin a pre-mechanism artifact. The refuter cannot verify the assertion from the compiled subject.

cells.label: Why this verdict
cells.value: Names its purpose in the story's words and supplies the mechanism the story needs: every operator-named shape classified into the founding taxonomy, at least twelve new units lowered through harness-v1 into the Contributor build, and each retired always-on sentence pinned by hash with its absence asserted, so prose lower and mechanism higher is derived rather than relabeled. Criterion 4's reverse-mapping fixture and the verifier's restatement search close the obvious loophole of removing a sentence no unit covers. The core bet's rule that source incidents preserve what was felt and regression fixtures show where constructions diverge is honored by one fixture per unit and by the reviewer reading each incident summary against its ledger reference. Exclusion 6 is respected: the denominator is pinned to the intake capture hash and the operator's attestation is disclosed rather than turned into an observed count. Creates feedback.migration. Surfaces: the engineer authors the units; the tester owns the per-unit fixture and the restatement search, which is a finding about the shape; devops gets the ledger's check mode. What it leaves is the horizon's largest gap: one batch, a named candidate for the rest, and no route from a live correction to a unit.

cells.label: Why this verdict
cells.value: A build-first, concurrent evidence runner with per-case reporting moves no capability row and no thesis; it changes how this repository's gate runs, not what the product does. The observed gap is real: the serial chain exercises the release script against whatever skeleton build exists before the forced rebuild, so a green run can be green against stale code. The fix is the devops question answered: a repeated step becomes a checked mechanism with named cases. Not drift: criterion 3 reports measured wall time with its method, criterion 1 compares the runner's table against the previous chain and refuses silent removal of a suite, and the non-goals keep the mutation self-test and golden checks in the default gate, which satisfies exclusion 6's refusal of invented numbers and weakened checks. Only devops gets a surface; the tester role's domain is shapes, not suite runners.

cells.label: Why this verdict
cells.value: The thesis text is nearly the title: the workstream application develops Horizon 1 through concrete journeys and gradual workflow replacement, including one outcome spanning multiple repositories. Criterion 4's four measures, restatements, manual handoffs, unnecessary interruptions, and time to a trusted return state, are the mission thesis's list of babysitting costs turned into counted evidence, and criterion 6's zero-restatement pass condition tests the one-paragraph story's build-not-biography claim on a fork. Not drift: the baseline is labeled an operator attestation that enters the repository only as hashes, an unknown baseline yields unverified and never passed, and the framework decision is deferred to a later ADR, so the application identity the thesis leaves open is not closed here. Surfaces: the showrunner gets the workstream index and board across repositories and the convergence of verification and final review in the launchpad; the engineer gets a named build element for every restatement the executor needed by hand; devops gets the launchpad and publish machinery under a real run; the product lead gets product 12's sections moved to evidenced or recorded as failed. Two defects to fix at activation. First, criterion 4 says the baseline is never called observed and then requires the run to be lower than the observed baseline; the verifier must read that as run count against attested count or the receipt will present an attested number as observed, which exclusion 6 forbids. Second, the only dated capability row is consumer.angular, the by-product, while the multi-repository workstream itself lands only in prose; launchpad.starter should move on this evidence or the table under-reports the horizon's central claim.

cells.label: Why this verdict
cells.value: A ledger order, a spec-versus-receipt boundary, generated release history, and a docs check move no capability row; criterion 6's capability-table work folds addenda into rows for work already shipped and forbids any level a cited final review does not support, which is bookkeeping under exclusion 6, not a capability move. The cold-start reduction in criterion 5 borrows WO-039's method and refuses relocation with a pointer as a way to pass, which keeps it from being a biography moved next door; but the reduction is by relocation rather than compilation, so it serves the one-paragraph story only indirectly and earns no thesis credit of its own. Not drift. Surfaces: the showrunner gets release history generated from annotated tags and release list, which answers what each release contained from the record instead of three hand-kept tables; the product lead gets one row per capability and product documents free of dated receipts, which is durable product understanding; devops gets the lineage check, the docs check, and the marker check in the chain. The boundary with WO-040 is explicit in WO-040 criterion 4, where no sentence a batch unit covers may be nominated here, and that is the right seam.

cells.label: Why this verdict
cells.value: The differentiated-interface thesis lists 5S first among the patterns that compile into exact mechanics and names the socket-and-link build as a view. Multi-active link groups with shared supports, piece-count set bonuses lowered to statechart gates, evidence obligations, verifier episodes, and cadences that arm and go dark with the real state machine, and a tooltip per piece with declared cost and semantic hash are that sentence executed; it is also Horizon 2's first compiler-side slice. The core bet's rule that a new idea becomes one missing primitive or boundary rather than an opaque special case is met by the additive sets collection with an exact normalization rule, no new graph schema version, and every existing program's hash unchanged in criterion 1. Exclusion 3 holds: the set is a compiled example equipped by an example actor and the kernel is unchanged. Creates compiler.five-s-set. Surfaces: the engineer gets the composition and its cost answer through the link-budget diagnostic and the tooltip; the tester gets a dark and armed fixture per bonus plus a live-versus-replay identity scenario, which is the tester's own question in the roles table; devops gets the compiler extension. The non-goals defer the authoring surface and the rest of the shelf to named candidates.
